positions.name: MissingIdFailureHandling
positions.frame: what defines acceptable handling of the missing-id failure pattern in the id derivation pipeline?
positions.why: Both expressions concern the same production failure scenario in the id derivation pipeline — src-1 characterizes the failure pattern being reproduced (a markdown heading with no id field), and src-2 sets the binding constraints for acceptable resolution (no crash, valid slug). The conviction gradient from plain assertion to settled requirement tracks a problem-to-constraint arc under one shared technical read; the tension between describing a failure and mandating its handling is held, not resolved.
